scheme_name: Proposed one-time settlement of pending transport fines
note: Maharashtra's transport department proposed a one-time settlement in August 2025: two- and three-wheeler owners would pay 25% of pending dues (effectively a 75% waiver), with smaller waivers for costlier vehicles, against roughly ₹2,500 crore outstanding statewide (over ₹1,000 crore in Mumbai alone). As of 13 August 2026 this remains a proposal under review — no government order has been issued, so no discount is actually available. Until one is, the only settlement route is a National Lok Adalat sitting.
